notes.title: Chapter 9 and Chapter 10 updated
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Divers,[/h2][h2]We’ve been listening closely to your feedback, and we know a lot of you had frustrations with certain chapters. Today’s update is all about making your experience smoother, more engaging, and less repetitive. Here’s what’s changing:[/h2][p][/p][p][/p][p]           [b]Chapter 9 – Streamlined Exploration[/b][/p][p][b]            Goal:[/b] Reduce unnecessary back-and-forth.[/p][list][*][p] [b]Battery Requirement Reduced[/b] – You’ll now only need to place [b]2 batteries instead of 4[/b] to progress.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]More Creature Encounters[/b] – Added additional creatures to keep the tension high.[/p][/*][*][p] [b]New Submarine Mechanic[/b] – In 2-Player Mode, the player in the sub can now [b]fire missiles to blast through rock walls[/b], opening up new paths.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p] [b]UI & Control Updates[/b] – The submarine HUD and controls have been reworked for clarity and smoother gameplay.


[b]Chapter 10 – Quality of Life Upgrade[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]           Goal:[/b] Improve overall flow and reduce frustration.[/p][list][*][p][b]Less Falling Debris[/b] – Rock and debris drops have been reduced by [b]40%[/b], giving you more breathing room.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Missile Mechanic Added[/b] – Just like Chapter 9, the submarine can now [b]blast rock walls[/b] to help you push forward.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]UI & Control Updates[/b] – Same submarine updates carried over for consistency.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]We Hear You[/h3][p]Your feedback continues to shape the game. These changes are just the start—keep sharing your thoughts with us, and we’ll keep improving Deepest Trench together.[/p][p][/p][p]Dive safe,
[b]The Deepest Trench Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Deepest Trench is Now Live – Dive into the Depths!
notes.notes:
Hello, divers!

The day is finally here – Deepest Trench is live on Steam, and we’re thrilled to welcome you to the adventure! 🎉 Over the past months, we've worked hard to create a local co-op experience that plunges you into the unknown, tasking you and your friends with a top-secret mission in the Mariana Trench. With immersive visuals and teamwork-driven gameplay, we hope you'll find every dive filled with discovery, mystery, and excitement.

Since launch, we’ve loved watching players explore the depths, uncover secrets, and overcome the unique challenges of underwater survival. Whether you’re navigating with friends on the couch or connecting remotely through Steam’s Remote Play Together, there’s a thrill waiting at every turn.

We’d love to hear your stories, strategies, and feedback as you dive into the trench! Drop a comment here or share your thoughts in the community forum. Your feedback helps us keep refining and improving the experience.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey. Dive in, and let the adventure begin!

See you at the bottom,
The Favor Games Team

notes.title: Deepest Trench Soundtrack Available October 30th!
notes.notes:
[b][h3]This contains the full soundtrack for Deepest Trench plus any test songs, or otherwise unreleased tracks. [/h3][/b]

The songs in this OST can be used in any videos or live broadcasts as long as those videos or live broadcasts are not being used to advertise in any way. Further, directly reuploading the songs in this OST with no other content is prohibited.

The intention is that you can use the songs as background music on your Twitch Streams or YouTube Streams/Videos without worry of DMCA. Not to include the songs in advertising stuff or put them in your games or trailers.

notes.title: Demo Release Announcement
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! 

We at Favor Games would like to take the time to personally thank each and every single one of you for entrusting us with your entertainment experience! We are incredibly excited to present our demo to the public for you to enjoy and provide your valuable feedback! 

The current demo will allow you to play through the end of Chapter three, at which point we hope that you have managed to begin forming an opinion of the game. As time goes on, and the game is released in the next few months, we hope that experiencing this piece of the journey will provide you with the desire to continue the story and enjoy your time throughout. 

We will be working diligently to address any and all issues that may be pointed out to us through this, and we again cannot thank you enough for your faith in us, our game, and the future that this will create for all of us as players and developers alike. Feel free to leave any and all issues, compliments, suggestions, or complaints for us to review and use to improve the player experience. 


The Favor Games Team
